checkedAlternates.risk: The identity matrix is symmetric and orthogonal.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Identity I is a special diagonal matrix (group-2), whereas group-4 holds general transpose/adjoint classes.

checkedAlternates.risk: The zero matrix has zeros off the diagonal.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The zero matrix is uniquely defined by having every entry equal to 0 (group-1).
